descriptions.w3d_d24e_register_message_list_propertie: Registers Columns (0x801eff8c) with a guarded function-local static descriptor built once from a zero-filled temporary; registers Messages (0x801efff0) with a guarded function-local static descriptor built once from a zero-filled temporary; sets the FontResource string binding (0x801ed24c) to a temporary string made from "FE.Font" (0x803b6408, constructor 0x8020bb54); registers FontSize (0x801ec52c); calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
